steps.id: Buka sekolahsabilillah.sch.id, buat akun (pilih satuan pendidikan dan jalur), unggah Kartu Keluarga.
steps.en: Go to sekolahsabilillah.sch.id, create an account (choose unit and track), upload the family card.

steps.id: Transfer biaya pendaftaran Rp450.000 ke virtual account BNI.
steps.en: Pay the Rp450,000 registration fee to the BNI virtual account.

steps.id: Login dengan NIK calon siswa, isi biodata dan unggah berkas.
steps.en: Log in with the child's NIK, fill in the profile and upload documents.

steps.id: Ikuti wawancara kesiapan belajar/seleksi sesuai jadwal dengan membawa bukti pendaftaran.
steps.en: Attend the readiness interview/selection with the registration receipt.

notes.id: Jalur: prestasi undangan, inden internal/eksternal, reguler internal/eksternal. Berdasarkan artikel Juli 2024; tahun ajaran diasumsikan.
notes.en: Tracks: invited achievers, early internal/external, regular internal/external. Based on a July 2024 article; academic year assumed.

source.title: Biaya Masuk SMA Islam Sabilillah Malang & Cara Pendaftaran (Hai Malang)
